card.text: Explore Neptune’s retrograde moon through Voyager monochrome and enhanced-color imagery.

introduction.text: Neptune’s largest moon follows a retrograde orbit. Voyager revealed nitrogen frost, strange cantaloupe terrain and active geyser-like plumes.

normal.title: Clear-filter mosaic
normal.summary: Each image is corrected using its capture geometry before joining the mosaic. Missing coverage and unreliable views stay empty.

enhanced.title: Enhanced-color map
enhanced.summary: Orange, green and blue bands form an enhanced-color view. Detail varies; the unlit northern region stays unavailable.
